source.title: Disenchanting doesn't match expected classic result for green weapons item level 21-30, issue #351
source.author: guruuluru

quote: Results were recorded automatically with an addon from the loot window after each Disenchant cast.
notes: EXPLICIT NON-RETAIL GAME FLAVOR: WoW Forever Classic Beta PvP, client build 70374, October 13-15 2026; original reports Enchanting skill 56-60 across full 22-cast sample, not at each cast. Input is uncommon (green) weapon, client item level 21. Exactly 2 individual per-cast outcomes were enumerated for this input ID. Per-output 0 bin is directly counted from the other enumerated casts on that SAME input; not an overall no-loot zero. This beta exhibited a known disenchant-pool bug; MUST BE QUARANTINED from Retail/regular Classic baseline until Master confirms game-version exclusion. No Retail live eligibility inferred.
skill: Enchanting 56-60 across experiment (individual cast skill unknown)

source.title: Wicked Leather Headband — archived Thottbot firsthand 20-disenchant report
source.author: Unidentified Thottbot commenter

quote: For 20 dissenchants my results were: 9 GEE 1 LB and 23 illusion dust
notes: Original archived Thottbot first-person cohort. 20 completed Wicked Leather Headband disenchants (Classic uncommon leather head, historical item level 56) and three source-reported unit totals. Distinct from previously captured 30-, 37-, 69- and approximately 230-headband samples; duplicate language across locale mirror pages is NOT another cohort. Per-output hits, zeros, 1/2 stack histograms, exact patch/skill, and Retail eligibility NOT given; do not equate units with hits or infer zero counts.
